This is Pom, a sock puppet. Pom has a brand new red kite.
Whoosh! The wind lifts the kite up high.
Oh no! The kite is stuck in the tall tree.
Pom tugs and tugs. The kite will not come down.
What happens next? Tap an ending.
Pom's friend Dot comes by with a long stick. Together they wiggle the kite free!
Pom finds paper and string, and makes a brand new kite, all by herself.
Pom sits under the tree and waits. A soft breeze drops the kite right down.
